definitions.explanation: The medical or formal term for nasal mucus or discharge. Used in clinical contexts. In everyday speech, {鼻水|はなみず} is far more common.

examples.japanese: {鼻汁|びじゅう}が{止|と}まらない。
{医師|いし}は{鼻汁|びじゅう}の{色|いろ}から{細菌感染|さいきんかんせん}を{疑|うたが}った。
examples.english: The doctor suspected a bacterial infection from the color of the nasal discharge.

examples.japanese: {鼻汁|びじゅう}の{検査|けんさ}でインフルエンザが{陽性|ようせい}と{判明|はんめい}した。
examples.english: A nasal discharge test revealed a positive result for influenza.

notes:
Medical and formal equivalent of {鼻水|はなみず}. Found in medical records, clinical descriptions, and formal writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鼻汁|びじゅう}が{出|で}る: nasal discharge appears
- {黄色|きいろ}い{鼻汁|びじゅう}: yellow nasal discharge (sign of infection)
- {水様性|すいようせい}{鼻汁|びじゅう}: watery nasal discharge
- {鼻汁|びじゅう}{検査|けんさ}: nasal discharge test

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鼻水|はなみず}: runny nose — the standard everyday term
